say:2:1130929001:1.text: ...It's Asuna's parents. They were hit by falling rocks while digging a tunnel up in the highlands.
say:2:1130929001:1.source_cn: ……是阿苏纳的父母。他们在高原上开凿隧道的时候，被落石...

say:3:1130929002:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate fooled all of us into doing their dirty work, but her parents... they won't be coming back.
say:3:1130929002:1.source_cn: 我们这些人是一起被黑金骗去做工的，但她的父母……再也回...

say:4:1130929003:1.text: It must be so hard for her to see all these families reuniting around her.
say:4:1130929003:1.source_cn: 不知道她看到其他人一家团圆的场景，该有多难受。

say:5:1130929004:1.text: Yeah, and Asuna's never been much of a talker, either...
say:5:1130929004:1.source_cn: 是啊，而且阿苏纳本来就不爱说话……

say:6:1130929005:1.text: Just give her some space for now. With any luck, she'll feel better in a couple of days.
say:6:1130929005:1.source_cn: 还是先别打扰她了，也许过段日子，她会好受一点。

say:7:1130929006:1.text: Either way, we have to be there for her.
say:7:1130929006:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，我们都会陪着她的。
